steps: Register for the Affidian CU Refer a Friend program.
Share your personal referral link with friends/family via email, text, or social media.
Friend registers via your link, joins, and opens a new personal checking account within 60 days.
Friend enrolls in eStatements within 60 days of account opening.
You receive a $100 Visa Reward Card (4-6 weeks).
timing: Visa Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Visa Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed. — structural: the reward is fulfilled as a mailed physical card (4-6 weeks) — no electronic payout option per terms.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The reward arrives as a physical card by mail (4-6 weeks); no expedite option exists in the terms — factor mail time into expectations.
Volume constraint noted in terms: cap text is inconsistent on the page ('up to $1900 per year' / 'up to ten cards val — plan referral count against the cap, not the calendar.
